A '''member of the Jedi Order''' was active during the [[Great Sith War/Legends|Great Sith War]], during which he led a [[Bombing run|bombing raid]] against the [[Mandalorian Crusaders]]. One of his bombs killed [[Varda]], the Mandalorian lover of Jedi Knight [[Dorjander Kace]], who had been living among the Mandalorians since they captured him earlier in the war.
